title: Standing Terms of the Equity Desk on Restatements and Allocation Holds Under Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
An allocation already posted under Membership and Patronage Equity is restated only where the volume behind it was wrong, where the member's class changed with effect on that year, or where a death has been recorded with effect on it, and only within the class's restatement window counted in whole fiscal years back from the current fiscal year.

**What a restatement does.** A restatement takes the units off the membership and posts the allocation afresh.

**The hold.** While a restatement or a disputed volume is being worked the membership is put under an allocation hold, which stops allocation being posted but does not stop qualifying business accruing, and the hold runs no longer than the class's hold maximum in calendar days from the day it was set, after which allocation resumes on the figures then on record.

**A disputed volume.** A member who disagrees with the volume behind an allocation may ask for the underlying settlements or invoices to be re-examined, and the desk registers that and puts the hold on; a member who simply believes the board's rate should have been higher is asking about a board decision, and no policy here can move it.

## A clause of this instruction no longer in force

The words "posts the allocation afresh at the rate declared for the year restated, never at this year's rate" are **no longer in force**, and are set down only so that no reader applies them. The rate a restated allocation is now worked out at on each basis is governed by the current basis, which is carried with the restatement rules. The three occasions for a restatement, the window, the hold and its maximum stand as clauses in force.

## The window, on hypothetical years

The window is counted in whole fiscal years back from the current fiscal year, and the boundary year itself falls inside it. On a class whose window is 3 fiscal years and a current fiscal year of 2026, an allocation posted for 2023 is inside the window, and one posted for 2022 is outside it. The class's own window figure and its hold maximum are the figures the class carries.

## Points of judgement

| The member says | Is it an occasion for a restatement |
| --- | --- |
| bushels settled in the year were never counted | yes, the volume behind the allocation was wrong |
| the class changed with effect on that year | yes |
| a death has been recorded with effect on that year | yes |
| the board's rate for the year was too low | no; that is a board decision |

superseded_clauses: posts the allocation afresh at the rate declared for the year restated, never at this year's rate
